unresolved.reason: Open/closed state follows the Europe/London clock at render. The trace did not stub Date, so it saw whichever state applied at run time. There is no timer: the badge updates on the next render.
Reached by setting state.w, not by resizing the window; CSS clamp()/vw values still follow the real viewport.
The credit-account, Ltd/LLP and separate-delivery field sets are defined in the schema getter and filtered in renderVals; the trace did not drive them.
Careers and Catalogue rely on native required attributes; the browser validation bubble is not part of the draft.
